newsitem.title: CHINA: China Marine unit wins 100m yuan order.
newsitem.headline: China Marine unit wins 100m yuan order.

text.p: A subsidiary of China International Marine Containers (Group) Ltd has won a 100-million-yuan purchase order for 49 aeroplane boarding bridges, a China Marine spokeswoman said on Friday.
Shenzhen Tianda Airport Support Co Ltd, 51 percent controlled by China Marine, would make the bridges for Beijing's international airport for delivery in June 1998, the official said.
Tianda beat bidders from the United States and Japan for the order, she told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin, but declined to give further details.
China Marine, based in Shenzhen, is the country's largest marine container maker.
Boarding bridges accounted for 3.1 percent of China Marine's 1996 sales of 3.48 billion yuan, the listed company's 1996 annual report showed.
